job_card_note:
New job

Boom tent, fastened to boom with centre mount track and bolt rope. Made from weatherMAX light charcoal. Down to lifelines with shock cord and plastic hooks. Zip on each side as discussed for easy access. I recommend using the weatherMAX for this job as there is a lot of material and would be to heavy if made from canvas. Price $4,540 + gst.

As discussed you can take advantage of the 5% discount off this price, after leaving an outstanding review.
